_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Reading ECB rates and calculating indicators...

description: Calculates indicators for a currency pair. Use it when the user names a currency pair and wants indicators, such as "RSI and MACD for EUR/USD" or "50-day SMA for USD/JPY on the weekly chart". Best for the 30 ECB currencies; it reads the European Central Bank's daily euro reference rates, one closing rate a day. Input tips: pass symbol as two ISO currency codes (for example EUR/USD), interval 1d (default) or 1w, and indicators from sma, ema, rsi, macd and bollinger; optionally periods and series_length. Returns the latest value and a short series for each indicator, with the source and the date of the last rate. Not for: stocks, crypto, forecasts, or buy or sell advice. For atr, stochastic, vwap or any non-currency asset, use compute_indicators with the user's own candles. Informational only, not financial advice; gives no signals.

indicators.description: Indicators to calculate from the ECB closing rates, such as ["rsi", "macd"]: sma, ema, rsi, macd (12, 26, 9) and bollinger (2 standard deviations)

interval.description: 1d (one value per ECB fixing, the default) or 1w (the last fixing of each week)

periods.description: Lookback length per indicator, in candles, such as {"sma": 50}. Any left out use the default shown. Whole numbers from 2 to 100.

series_length.description: How many of the most recent values to return for each indicator, such as 10. 5 by default.

symbol.description: Currency pair of two ISO codes, such as "EUR/USD" or "USDJPY". Both codes must be ECB currencies: AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CNY, CZK, DKK, EUR, GBP, HKD, HUF, IDR, ILS, INR, ISK, JPY, KRW, MXN, MYR, NOK, NZD, PHP, PLN, RON, SEK, SGD, THB, TRY, USD, ZAR. Not a stock or crypto ticker.

name: get_indicators

asOf.description: Date or time of the last price used, or the date of the call when no price was read

candles.description: Number of candles the indicators were calculated over. 0 when the call was refused before any price was read.

error.description: Present when status is not ok: a stable code, what went wrong and what to do next.

code.description: Stable code, such as invalid_symbol, invalid_prices, invalid_periods or nothing_to_calculate

hint.description: The next step: what to change in the call or tell the user

indicators.description: One entry per calculated indicator, in the order asked. Empty when status is not ok.

latest.description: One value of the indicator at one candle

index.description: Position of the candle, 0 is the oldest

time.description: Time of the candle as given, or the ECB rate date; null when the candle had none

value.description: Moving average, in the price unit

series.description: The most recent values, oldest first, ending with latest
